The only focus cue appears to be indirect: onfocus="toggleActivation('indicator-act'); ..." toggles separate <span class="indicator solid"> elements, not a visible focus indicator on the focused control itself, and its visibility depends entirely on external CSS/JS.
issues.persona_impact: If the browser’s default focus ring is suppressed, I can’t reliably see where keyboard focus is. I lose my place immediately when tabbing through the links, especially if the indicator spans are subtle, off to the side, or not visually obvious.
issues.recommendation: Do not remove focus outlines unless you replace them with an equally visible focus style on the focused link itself (e.g., .no-focus-default:focus { outline: 2px solid #000; outline-offset: 2px; } or :focus-visible). evaluation.overall_assessment: As a keyboard-only user, I can tab to these links, but the HTML suggests the default focus indicator is being disabled and replaced with a fragile JS/CSS-based cue, so I can’t count on always seeing where I am.
